baseline.law: A browser lacking cross-origin isolation still runs admitted portable operations (BWH0-AC2).

productionIsolation.effect: the deployed playground (Netlify) is cross-origin isolated in engines that honor COOP/COEP; no shipped playground source uses SharedArrayBuffer or crossOriginIsolation today
productionIsolation.law: Production-deployed isolation headers are recorded here, never a baseline prerequisite (BWH0-AC2): every admitted operation runs without crossOriginIsolation, and the threaded-wasm strategy stays optional (BWH5).

optionalStrategies.law: Threaded WASM is an optional verified execution strategy, never an implicit prerequisite and never a silent default (BWH0.3).

rules: No admitted operation, engine requirement or strategy may make SharedArrayBuffer or cross-origin isolation a prerequisite for baseline execution; such a row is rejected (BWH0-AC2).
An operation that needs the threaded strategy either carries its own verified evidence under BWH5 or loses admission; it never degrades the baseline.
Minimum engine versions are pinned only by real qualification evidence (BWH11 parity terminal, VSW5 web matrix); guessing versions here is forbidden.

The live playground must not acquire SharedArrayBuffer or crossOriginIsolation usage — in shipped sources or in deployed isolation headers (netlify.toml) — without this matrix recording it; the harness grounds both in the live repository.
